title: Exactly, all and at least
text: An input arc states how many tokens a transition needs and how many it takes: `exactly(2)` needs and takes two, `all` needs one and takes every token, `atLeast(3)` needs three and then takes every token. Tokens are taken oldest first.

steps.text: The arc `exactly(2)` of `pair` takes the two oldest `orders`. Four are left.
The arc `all` of `sweep` drains `returns`: three tokens in one firing.
Four orders meet `atLeast(3)`, and the firing of `batch` takes all four.
The place `orders` is empty, and `exactly(2)` needs two.
